item.title: Renfrew County council approves 2026 budget with 6.68% levy increase
item.description: Renfrew County council has approved its 2026 budget, setting the county’s spending and tax levy for the coming year in the face of rising costs and the increasing service demands faced by municipalities across Ontario. item.title: Ottawa Valley youth speed skater to represent Ontario at nationals
item.description: COBDEN – Twelve-year-old Renfrew speed skater Clara McKendry is set to take the next step in her young athletic career, qualifying to compete at the Canadian youth championships after only four years in the sport. item.title: Ontario invests $38.6M in Renfrew–Nipissing–Pembroke water upgrades
item.description: The Ontario government is committing more than $38.6 million toward water and wastewater infrastructure upgrades in Pembroke, Laurentian Valley, Whitewater Region, Renfrew and Bonnechere Valley, funding that municipal officials say will address aging systems while supporting current and future residential growth across the region.
